description: 100 questions on Python while loops (coding questions, beginner to intermediate)

questions.question:
What does this print?
count = 0
while count < 3:
    print(count)
    count += 1
What is the risk if a while condition never becomes False?
questions.answer: An infinite loop that runs forever

questions.question: How do you write an infinite loop?
questions.answer: while True: (usually with a break inside to exit)

questions.question: What is the difference between break and continue?
questions.answer: break exits the whole loop; continue skips only the current iteration

While loops use a condition. Which value makes a while loop run at least once guaranteed?
questions.answer: None guaranteed - the condition is checked first. Use a do-while pattern (run body, then check) if needed.
